Hi there! I have hemiplegic migraines, which are stroke mimicking migraines. I notice you do lots of informational articles on your app, I was just reading one on when someone should go to the ER for a migraine. I saw you mention stroke, but nothing about aura, only headache. I think it’s important to educate people on the very real,and less uncommon than you may think, stroke-like migraines. I’ve been told by my doctor that one-sided weakness that hits immediately may be a stroke, I think it would be also important to tell people about that. I understand that regular migraines are awful, but this is a very real differential diagnosis as well that’s just as awful and real. Thank you for reading this.

title.label: Need to be able to edit dosage when using mg/ml

content.label:
When trying to add new medications and edit their strength, we need a better editing tool in the mg/ml feature. As of right now there is no way to dictate if the dosage is something like “4mg(5ml)” because the only option is to enter numbers and periods when editing the strength, there is no ability to add a dash (/) in order to show what the actual mg to ml dosage is.
Not all medications are equivalent in their mg to ml dosage (meaning not all medications will be a perfect “4mg(4ml)” so it makes tracking more difficult. It would be as simple as letting us add a “/“ when editing the dosage, because right now the only things we can enter are numbers and a period, which does nothing to help properly track liquid dosing.
